title: ALL CAPS: THE HISTORY OF THE AMERICAN BASEBALL HAT
chaptersLine: Forty-plus chapters drafted, plus an introduction and a closing coda.
spanLine: From before the Civil War to the drops of 2026.
thisWeek: A two week reconciliation pass opened on the manuscript, with a full backup taken before the sync.
The photo list grew again, a working checklist that now runs across baseball, football, basketball, hockey and the minor leagues.
No new research intakes landed this week, the time went to revision and to lining up the images.
chapterHighlights: The teal and purple years, when four different leagues at once decided a cap should look like that.
Franchises that folded and kept selling caps anyway, long after the last game.
Minor league clubs that borrow a second name for one night, and the caps that come out of it.
The tag inside the crown, and what a label can prove about where a hat has been.
